The main takeaway from our work is that

the model-matching control approach can be applied to the control design of a robot performing compliant manipulation on dynamic environment, and the reference model should be designed according to the dynamics of environment.

the control design of compliant manipulator is a problem of model matching, where the reference model is selected according to environment dynamics, while considering the robot actuator output limitation and its contact discontinuity.

the model-matching approach is more effective than impedance control approach in terms of the robot's performance in following up the input trajectory and in manipulating adaptively on dynamic constrained space.
